title: onobrychis aequidentata f. dalmatica
intro: Onobrychis aequidentata f. dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian sainfoin, is a plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae) that has been traditionally used in folk medicine. Dalmatian sainfoin has been used to treat a variety of health issues, including its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of Dalmatian sainfoin include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Dalmatian sainfoin have been reported to include flavonoids like kaempferol and quercetin, phenolic acids like ferulic acid, and alkaloids like onobrychine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
